title: Palindrome Number
statement_short: Given an integer x, return true if x is a palindrome, and false otherwise. Solve it without converting the integer to a string.
hint: No-string conversion follow-up calls for reversing the back half of the integer via modulo 10 digit extraction.
keywords: without converting the integer to a string
why_not: Right: Math / Geometry extracts and reverses the second half of the integer using modulo 10 arithmetic in O(log10 n) time and O(1) space. Not Two Pointers: Converting to a string allows two pointers inward scan, but violates the explicit no-string conversion constraint. Not Stack: Digit stack pushing handles reversal, but consumes extra memory violating O(1) space. Not Bit Manipulation: Bitwise shifts operate on base-2 representations, whereas decimal palindrome rules rely on base-10 digits.
